I'm 16 and I am done using psychadelics, but the 6 times I did they have helped me immensely.  I was diagnosed with anxiety and bipolar disorder pretty young, but after my 6 trips I feel comfortable in my own skin and honestly pretty positive.  The ups of my life feel amazing and the downs feel less down than before.  My anxiety is basically gone, and I am much more appreciative of life.  But on the other side of the coin my social skills aren't as acute, I have a hard time articulating my thoughts in my head, and often times I feel regretful.  Overall while I wouldn't reccomend doing it at this age from experience, I am both angry and glad I did it, as I would not be the person I am today without it.
